# CPIN.JK — house coverage rates it BUY

Signal: the South Research division published coverage (v4) with a 12-month target of Rp3,945.0 against Rp2,450.0 (expected total return 70.4%). Why now: the rating crossed the BUY band on the engine's probability-weighted target.

Archetype guess: washout_rebound · method card: per fund record routing for Poultry, feed & protein.

Sharpest questions for a thesis:
- The D&A restatement appears to double-count against opex. The pack has GP 12,420.5 less opex 4,287.3 equals EBIT 8,133.1 and EBITDA 8,443.6 equals EBIT plus D&A 310.5, so D&A sits inside opex. The forecast applies opex a
- Section 3 says "Accruals are clean" citing FY2025 (OCF 5,774 against NP 5,644), which is true of that year but not of the period this note reports. The same pack shows LTM OCF of 1,873 against LTM NP of 7,461, an accrual
- FY2026E FCFF of 5,131 implies operating cash flow near 6,900 (NP 7,293 plus D&A 1,287 less delta NWC 1,618) against the pack's LTM OCF of 1,873, and delta NWC of 1,618 against +6,756 in the nine months, with nwc_pct fixe

Regime stance vs the macro desk is UNASSESSED: IDEATION/CONSTRUCT sets WITH / NEUTRAL / AGAINST before any deep-dive. Fast-disqualify checks and the thesis itself follow the full analyst -> Bear -> Judge law.
